'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex O'Shea DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' TBO Hoth CR(V)
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
